projects.name: Projects.ProjectJournal.Create
projects.description: Adds project journal lines to an existing batch. Without lines, inserts blank lines with the BC defaults.

projects.name: Projects.ProjectJournal.Check
projects.description: Validates a project journal batch and returns readiness status.

projects.name: Projects.ProjectJournal.Post
projects.description: Posts a project journal batch and returns posting statistics.

projects.name: Projects.ProjectJournal.PreviewPost
projects.description: Simulates posting a project journal batch and returns the resulting ledger entries (Job Ledger Entry, Item Ledger Entry, G/L Entry where applicable) without committing changes.

projects.name: Projects.ProjectJournal.Update
projects.description: Deletes selected project journal lines from one existing batch and optionally renumbers its documents.

projects.name: Projects.Project.Create
projects.description: Creates project headers with optional tasks and planning lines.

projects.name: Projects.Project.Update
projects.description: Updates project headers with optional tasks and planning lines.

projects.name: Projects.Task.Create
projects.description: Creates project tasks with optional planning lines.

projects.name: Projects.Task.Update
projects.description: Updates project tasks with optional planning lines.

projects.name: Projects.PlanningLine.Create
projects.description: Creates project planning lines.

projects.name: Projects.PlanningLine.Update
projects.description: Updates project planning lines.

projects.name: Projects.Project.Copy
projects.description: Copies a project with a task range and budget or billable planning lines.

projects.name: Projects.Project.SetStatus
projects.description: Changes project status or blocking through native Business Central validation.

projects.name: Projects.WIP.Get
projects.description: Reads calculated and posted project WIP entries.

projects.name: Projects.WIP.Calculate
projects.description: Calculates project work in progress through the native WIP engine.

projects.name: Projects.WIP.Post
projects.description: Posts calculated project WIP to the general ledger through native BC posting.

projects.name: Projects.Statistics.Get
projects.description: Returns native project budget, actual, billable and invoiced statistics in LCY.

projects.name: Projects.BudgetVsActual.Get
projects.description: Returns native project totals and posting-task budget versus actual statistics in LCY.

projects.name: Projects.Usage.Get
projects.description: Reads project task usage links and remaining planning quantities.

projects.name: Projects.Usage.Link
projects.description: Links posted project usage to a planning line or creates planning lines from usage through native BC.
